purpose: Prevent DWG VERTEX output from silently discarding model fields absent from the selected versioned record body.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

wireFields: same as VERTEX (3D), with a distinct object type
same as VERTEX (3D), with a distinct object type

implementation.behavior: Resolve the emitted DWG vertex object type before transaction staging. Reject a nonzero 2D vertex identifier through AC1021; reject nondefault start/end widths, bulge, tangent direction or identifier for 3D/MESH/PFACE coordinate records; reject nondefault point and noncanonical flags on PFACE face records. Preserve the canonical DXF face-role flag 128 because object type 0x0E carries that role.

acceptedProfiles: corrected MESH vertex after bulge refusal
corrected PFACE coordinate vertex after identifier refusal
PFACE face with canonical flags 128 after point refusal
generatedControls.failureRetry: Each refusal preserves the seeded writer buffer; correcting the omitted field allows the same writer to encode the vertex.

validation.fixturePolicy: Controls are generated in memory; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

limitations: Controls establish bounded encoder admission and rollback/retry only; they do not establish producer prevalence or complete topology semantics.
Native consumer behavior and broader format support remain unqualified.
supportClaimEffect: Closes only the tested silent-loss paths for omitted DWG VERTEX fields; no broad support claim is promoted.
